supernova.description: Supernova Launcher is a free, open-source Android launcher built to give you complete control over your home screen. From flexible grid layouts and precise icon positioning to custom icon packs, shapes, glass effects, and personalized folders, nearly every detail can be tailored to your style. It also offers customizable gestures, adjustable docks, smart folders, organized app drawer groups, and widget support, letting you create a setup that looks and works exactly how you want. Whether you prefer a clean, minimal home screen or a heavily customized layout, Supernova gives you the freedom to make your phone feel truly yours.
